standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that an irreducible component is closed and that the image of an irreducible subset is irreducible
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1367-1370)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes components closed and their images irreducible.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the restriction of an open map with irreducible fibres to the preimage of an irreducible subset again has irreducible fibres
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked near the end of the counted proof (source lines 1371-1372)
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the preimage of a component is irreducible.

core_obligations: Surjectivity of the map follows from the irreducibility of the fibres, since an irreducible fibre in particular is nonempty (proof lines 1363-1365)
Reduce to irreducibility of preimages: every irreducible subset of the source maps into a component, so it suffices to show that the preimage of a component is irreducible (proof lines 1366-1370)
Apply the fibre statement to the induced map over the component, which is open with irreducible fibres, and conclude (proof lines 1371-1372)
proof_roadmap: 由纤维不可约（特别非空）得 f 满。
取 Y 的不可约分支 T（闭）；由「不可约集的像不可约」知 X 的不可约子集都落在某个分支里，故只需证 f^{-1}(T) 不可约。
对限制 f^{-1}(T) → T，仍满足「开 + 纤维不可约」，由对应引理即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an open continuous map whose fibres are irreducible induces a bijection between the irreducible components of source and target (author lemma at source lines 1355-1361, label lemma-irreducible-fibres-irreducible-components). The proof (source lines 1363-1373) notes that the fibres being irreducible makes the map surjective, reduces to irreducibility of the preimage of a component and applies the corresponding fibre statement over that component (proof lines 1363-1372). The reduction to the preimage of a component is the substance. H3.
